summary: Minimal, correct fix that guards MaxLengthValidator creation on a non-null max_length, matching the existing BinaryField.__init__ precedent and removing the broken validator on bare CharField() output fields. No correctness, regression, or compatibility concerns.

issues.description: Concrete CharField model definitions without max_length now silently skip the MaxLengthValidator, but they are already rejected at system-check time (fields.E120), so user-facing behavior is unchanged; worth a mental note but not a regression.
